number.why: The source explicitly reports 103/295 versus 55/143 patients with serious adverse events through day 28. These are safety-population counts grouped by the first agent received, so the ruling correctly confirms the numbers and identifies the modified intention-to-treat label as incorrect.

quotes.span: In the safety population, serious adverse events occurred in 103 of 295 patients (34.9%) in the tocilizumab group and in 55 of 143 patients (38.5%) in the placebo group.
Safety was assessed in the population that included all the patients who had received a dose of tocilizumab or placebo, according to the trial agent that was first received.

In the safety population, adverse events were reported in 77.3% of 295 patients in the tocilizumab group and in 81.1% of 143 patients in the placebo group through day 28 (<xref rid="t3" ref-type="table">Table 3</xref>); serious adverse events were reported in 34.9% and 38.5%, respectively.

entry.why: Enrollment explicitly required adults with confirmed COVID-19 pneumonia, and the trial population was hospitalized. This establishes entry within the question's hospitalized adult COVID-19 population.

quotes.span: we enrolled adults (≥18 years of age) with severe Covid-19 pneumonia, as confirmed by positive polymerase-chain-reaction (PCR) assay of any body fluid and evidenced by bilateral chest infiltrates on chest radiography or computed tomography.
we randomly assigned patients who were hospitalized with severe Covid-19 pneumonia
